01

Executive Summary

At Camfire, I directed marketing across eight consumer and technology brands, managed C$2.6M in client budgets and led seven direct reports. The campaigns influenced $7.2M in pipeline, increased marketing ROI by 24% and reduced CPC by 18%.

02

The Challenge

Coordinate different brand priorities, investment and delivery across the portfolio. Each brand needed a clear direction, while marketers, designers and agency partners needed a shared way to assess performance.

03

The Execution

  1. Align the portfolio

    Connected brand, content and demand initiatives with the business objectives of each brand.

  2. Coordinate the delivery

    Led seven marketers and designers, setting channel priorities and testing standards.

  3. Test the investment

    Directed campaign testing and optimization across paid media.

  4. Extend the customer journey

    Delivered activation, engagement and retention programs across CRM, email and push marketing.
